scope: Refresh OpenCADStudio as an application-level consumer profile, examine its ACIS tessellation completeness boundary, and reconcile a new AC1032 MLeader-context peer report with the existing DWG/DXF implementation plan.

method.kind: Primary repository release/source/documentation review plus local plan reconciliation
method.evidenceBoundary: Repository docs, release metadata and issue reports describe candidate profiles and reported boundaries; they do not establish the behavior of libdxfrw outputs. OpenCADStudio's app-level consumer is correlated with ACadRust through opencadcodec; its self-readback is not an independent parser result. The ACadRust #134 report has no redistributable attached sample and is not a local defect report.

evidence.topic: OpenCADStudio release identity and documentation drift
observed: GitHub lists v2026.41 as latest at review time, released 2026-10-11 at commit cff240e.
The tagged README lists DWG/DXF read and versioned save targets from R14 through R2018.

The current main Cargo.toml identifies package version 2026.41.0 and pins opencadcodec 325fa98, opencadkernel dfca391 with the acis feature, and opencadgraph 5d4e713; these mutable-main dependency pins must not be assumed to equal the released tag's dependencies.
The opencadcodec repository identifies itself as forked from hakanaktt/acadrust.
The OpenAEC page still displays v2026.37 and an R13-R2018 range, unlike the current GitHub tag/README.
doesNotEstablish: per-family/version route completeness from product-level ranges
that main-branch engine pins match a released application artifact
an independent parser lineage from ACadRust
evidence.planUse: Use an immutable release/source profile for any optional consumer run. Resolve exact engine revisions from that release, hash the executable, record OS/architecture/operation, and inspect the actual output magic. Do not infer compatibility from stale or broad product copy.

evidence.topic: ACIS rendering is a projection with an explicit incomplete fallback
observed: The documented Solid3D/Region/Body/Surface path lifts ACIS into the application kernel and tessellates per face.
If the kernel cannot express a face, the renderer uses a direct per-surface LOD sampler and marks the mesh incomplete.
The kernel README describes itself as early and says most operations are not yet implemented.
doesNotEstablish: complete geometric interpretation for arbitrary ACIS bodies
exact B-rep topology, dimensions, or metrics from a displayed mesh
independence of the app's codec from the ACadRust lineage
evidence.planUse: Record body presence, kernel-lift result, fallback, incomplete status, omitted faces and displayed mesh as separate observations. An incomplete fallback is not a semantic pass; retain the independent shape-metric/native gate.

evidence.topic: Tagged application automation and external native audit separation
observed: The tagged automation documentation describes generated DWG 2000/2013/2018 and DXF 2000 acceptance controls.
Its Windows reference-CAD script opens generated DWGs read-only and runs AUDIT without repairs.
The app's own audit/save_verified flow reopens through the same application codec, so it is not an independent reader result.
doesNotEstablish: that these scripts were run against libdxfrw artifacts
Linux native-application acceptance from a Windows-only native audit script
exact ACIS semantics from application self-readback
evidence.planUse: At the existing composed checkpoint, optionally run the external reference audit against exact locally generated libdxfrw outputs in scratch storage. Preserve raw logs and report unavailable tooling as NOT_RUN.

observed: The open 2026-10-12 issue reports 70 of 351 real-world AC1032 drawings failing strict reads in v0.6.4 after passing in v0.6.3.
The report attributes 65 cases to AcDbMLeaderObjectContextData and identifies further associative-object and table cases.
The reporter says AutoCAD and ODA File Converter read the files, but cannot attach the production samples.
doesNotEstablish: a libdxfrw bug or a known local wire-layout mismatch
a reproducible sample or redistributable test fixture
that ACadRust v0.6.4 is a universal AC1032 reader oracle
evidence.planUse: Keep this release- and class-scoped peer evidence. When local MLeader context code is touched, use a bounded from-scratch/source-authored AC1032 control and following-record sentinel checked against local ODA v5.4.1; do not fetch or commit the private examples.

nextActions: Continue fast local implementation validation; optional peers and native tools must not block unrelated slices.
At the composed checkpoint, pin the exact OpenCADStudio release and engine dependencies; verify input/output AC code and artifact hashes.
Treat application self-audit, complete/incomplete rendering, native CAD audit and independent ACIS semantics as separate outcomes.
When MLeader context code is touched, use a valid generated AC1032 record and following-record sentinel if constructible from the authoritative spec; do not use inaccessible peer drawings.
Keep all six J items DEFERRED_EXTERNAL and non-promoting.
